phase_prompt.label: The Weighing of Identities
phase_prompt.summary: The moment of validation where individual stars are 'called' and checked. Their light intensifies, revealing internal geometric structures or glyphs.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Extreme close-up on a single 'Star of Heaven'. It is a glass sphere containing a burning core of blue-white plasma. Etched into the surface are faint, glowing Geez numerals or system identifiers. The background is a bokeh field of the dark dome. The object feels heavy and precious. Photorealistic macro photography, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting.
